requirement_text: Register patients and doctors using email, phone number, and strong password (minimum 8 alphanumeric characters).
annotator_notes: Explicit password criterion makes the requirement objectively assessable.

requirement_text: Support RBAC with Patient, Physician, Nurse, and Admin roles.
annotator_notes: The defined roles are testable, but there is no quantitative or threshold criterion.

requirement_text: Enforce MFA via OTP for all doctor and admin accounts.
annotator_notes: The requirement is objectively testable but contains no quantitative criterion.

requirement_text: Allow patients to update address, emergency contact, allergies, and medications.
annotator_notes: The functionality is testable, but no measurable criterion is specified.

requirement_text: Ingest vital signs every 5 minutes (configurable) and store them in a time-series database.
annotator_notes: Explicit frequency and storage target.

requirement_text: If no device data is received for more than 60 minutes, alert the patient and assigned nurse.
annotator_notes: Explicit 60-minute threshold and defined alert action.

requirement_text: Allow doctors to configure patient-specific warning and critical thresholds.
annotator_notes: Threshold configuration is testable, but the threshold criteria themselves are not specified.

requirement_text: Trigger Critical Alert with red banner, audible alarm, SMS, and push notification when thresholds are crossed.
annotator_notes: The required outputs are testable, but no quantitative criterion is given.

requirement_text: Encrypt video consultations end-to-end using WebRTC technology.
annotator_notes: Technology and encryption behavior are testable, but no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: Record consultations only with explicit consent from both parties and retain securely for 7 years.
annotator_notes: The seven-year retention period is measurable; 'securely' is insufficiently defined.

requirement_text: Ingest data from at least 10,000 concurrent devices.
annotator_notes: Explicit capacity requirement.

requirement_text: Maintain detailed patient-record access audit logs.
annotator_notes: 'Detailed' is undefined, making the acceptance condition insufficiently objective.

requirement_text: Enforce 10-minute inactivity timeout for clinical users.
annotator_notes: Explicit 10-minute threshold.

requirement_text: Design for low technical proficiency with large fonts, high contrast, and voice-over support.
annotator_notes: 'Low technical proficiency' is undefined and no concrete accessibility thresholds are specified.

requirement_text: 90% of new patients should pair a wearable and view vitals within 5 minutes without support.
annotator_notes: The requirement is measurable and verifiable, but 'should' weakens the mandatory obligation.

requirement_text: The system must allow receptionists to register a new patient by capturing Name, DOB, Contact Info, and Emergency Contact.
annotator_notes: Functionality is objectively testable but no quantitative or threshold criterion is specified.

requirement_text: The system must generate a unique Patient ID (format: PAT-YYYY-XXXXX) for every registration.
annotator_notes: Explicit identifier format provides an objective acceptance criterion.

requirement_text: The system must provide a global search bar to retrieve patient records using Name, Phone, or Patient ID within < 1 second.
annotator_notes: Explicit search fields and response-time threshold.

requirement_text: The system must maintain a versioned audit trail of all changes made to an EHR (who edited it, when, and what was changed).
annotator_notes: Required audit information is defined, but no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: The system must flag critical allergies (e.g., Penicillin) prominently in red across all screens to prevent medication errors.
annotator_notes: 'Prominently' is subjective and lacks an objective acceptance criterion.

requirement_text: The system must send an automated alert to the Procurement Manager when stock levels fall below a defined minimum threshold (reorder level).
annotator_notes: Explicit threshold-based trigger and recipient.

requirement_text: The system must generate tax-compliant invoices (GST/IRS compliant) and send a PDF copy to the patient's registered email.
annotator_notes: Compliance standard and PDF/email behavior are testable, but no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: The system should integrate with biometric fingerprint scanners for secure staff attendance marking.
annotator_notes: 'Should' weakens obligation and 'secure' lacks an objective security criterion.

requirement_text: The system must support HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) standards to exchange data with external labs.
annotator_notes: FHIR is recognized technical terminology; no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: The system must connect to an SMS Gateway (e.g., Twilio) to send appointment reminders to patients 24 hours in advance.
annotator_notes: Explicit 24-hour timing and defined integration behavior.

requirement_text: The system must be fully compliant with HIPAA (USA) and GDPR (Europe) regarding patient data privacy.
annotator_notes: Recognized regulatory standards provide objective compliance criteria, but no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: Session timeouts must occur after 10 minutes of inactivity for high-security roles (Doctors/Admins).
annotator_notes: Explicit 10-minute threshold.

requirement_text: The system must handle a load of up to 5,000 concurrent users during peak morning hours (9 AM - 11 AM) with a response time < 2 seconds.
annotator_notes: Explicit capacity, time window, and response-time criteria.

requirement_text: The User Interface must follow Material Design principles to ensure a consistent look and feel.
annotator_notes: 'Consistent look and feel' is subjective and lacks objective acceptance criteria.

requirement_text: The system must provide context-sensitive help (tooltips) for medical coding fields (ICD-10, CPT codes) to assist doctors in billing.
annotator_notes: The required tooltip behavior is testable, but no quantitative criterion is specified.

requirement_text: Students must be able to browse the course catalog by category or search keywords.
annotator_notes: Search functionality and filtering behavior are objectively testable.

requirement_text: Students must be able to view video lectures with a "Resume" feature (remembering the last watched timestamp).
annotator_notes: Resume behavior and timestamp persistence are objectively testable.

requirement_text: The system must automatically mark a lecture as "Completed" once the student watches 90% of the video.
annotator_notes: Explicit 90% threshold provides a clear acceptance criterion.

requirement_text: Educators must be able to create multiple-choice quizzes (MCQs).
annotator_notes: Quiz creation functionality is directly testable.

requirement_text: The system must automatically grade MCQ quizzes and provide instant feedback to the student.
annotator_notes: Automated grading and feedback behavior can be tested.

requirement_text: Educators must be able to create subjective assignments (upload file submission).
annotator_notes: Assignment creation and file submission behavior are testable.

requirement_text: Educators must be able to enter grades manually for subjective assignments.
annotator_notes: Manual grade-entry functionality is objectively testable.

requirement_text: Students must be able to view their overall grade and progress percentage per course.
annotator_notes: Display of grades and progress percentage is objectively testable.

requirement_text: The system must analyze a student's quiz results and viewing speed to recommend supplementary content.
annotator_notes: Recommendation behavior can be tested, although no quantitative recommendation threshold is specified.

requirement_text: If a student scores below 60% on a quiz, the system must recommend a "Remedial Video" on the failed topic.
annotator_notes: Explicit 60% threshold and resulting recommendation provide clear acceptance criteria.

requirement_text: The system must have a discussion forum for each course where students can post questions.
annotator_notes: Forum availability and question-posting functionality are testable.

requirement_text: Educators must receive notifications when a new question is posted in their course forum.
annotator_notes: Notification trigger and recipient can be objectively tested.

requirement_text: The system must notify students via email when their assignments are graded.
annotator_notes: Email notification behavior is objectively testable.

requirement_text: The web interface must be responsive and adaptable to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
annotator_notes: Responsive behavior across the specified device categories can be tested.

requirement_text: The dashboard must display a progress bar for ongoing courses.
annotator_notes: Presence and display behavior of the progress bar are testable.

requirement_text: The platform must support up to 1,000 concurrent users with a response time under 2 seconds.
annotator_notes: Explicit concurrency and response-time thresholds.

requirement_text: Video lectures must start buffering within 3 seconds of the play button being pressed.
annotator_notes: Explicit 3-second performance threshold.

requirement_text: The database query time for the course catalog must average less than 500ms.
annotator_notes: Explicit average query-time threshold.

requirement_text: All data transmitted between the client and server must be encrypted using TLS 1.3.
annotator_notes: TLS 1.3 is a specific and objectively verifiable technical standard.

requirement_text: User passwords must be hashed using BCrypt.
annotator_notes: BCrypt is a specific and objectively verifiable hashing technology.

requirement_text: User data privacy must comply with GDPR regulations (right to be forgotten, data export).
annotator_notes: Specific regulatory framework and explicit privacy obligations provide objective verification criteria.

requirement_text: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime (excluding scheduled maintenance windows).
annotator_notes: Explicit 99.9% availability threshold.

requirement_text: The system must perform automated backups of the database every 24 hours.
annotator_notes: Explicit 24-hour backup frequency.

requirement_text: The system must be localized for English and Spanish languages.
annotator_notes: The supported languages are explicitly specified and can be objectively verified.

requirement_text: 95% of new users must be able to successfully enroll in a course without assistance.
annotator_notes: Explicit 95% success criterion.

requirement_text: In the event of a video upload failure, the system must display a clear error message and allow the user to retry without losing the course setup.
annotator_notes: 'Clear error message' is subjective and lacks an objective acceptance criterion.

requirement_text: The server must interface with barcode scanners (USB connected) to accept inventory data.
The system should support integration with thermal label printers (Zebra) for generating shipping labels.
The SWAS must send navigation waypoints (X,Y coordinates) to the FMS via MQTT. The payload shall be JSON format.
The SWAS must consume incoming orders from SAP via a RESTful GET endpoint called /api/orders/pending. Response time must be under 500ms.
The main dashboard must display a live 3D heatmap of robot activity and zone congestion.
The Inventory Screen must provide a search filter by SKU, Batch Number, or Expiry Date.
The system shall automatically ingest new customer orders from the ERP every 5 minutes via the scheduled polling mechanism.
The system must validate that the quantity requested for each SKU is available in inventory before accepting the order.
Upon validation, the system shall group orders into waves (clusters) based on proximity of items to optimize robot travel distance.
The system shall assign specific pick/drop tasks to the nearest available AMR robot based on real-time location (GPS coordinate data).
The system must prioritize Express orders (Priority Level 1) over standard orders.
If a robot fails to complete a task within 10 minutes, the system shall retask the job to another robot and mark the original robot as Out of Service for diagnostics.
The system must perform a perpetual inventory count, updating stock levels in real-time every time a robot picks or drops an item.
The system must generate a Cycle Count report at the end of every shift, highlighting discrepancies between system stock and physical scans.
The system shall block the processing of orders for any SKU with stock < reorder threshold (minimum level) and send an alert to the Inventory Controller.
The system must process an incoming order from ERP and generate a robot task in under 2 seconds.
The real-time inventory database must support up to 1,500 transactions per second (TPS) during peak hours.
The 3D dashboard UI must refresh robot positions with a latency of less than 500ms (near real-time).
The System must support a minimum of 50 concurrent robot control sessions without degradation.
The system shall maintain the following core relational tables: Robot_Table, Inventory_Table, and Order_Table with the specified fields.
All time-stamped telemetry data shall be stored in a separate InfluxDB time-series database with a retention policy of 30 days.
User access must be governed by Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Default role is Read-Only.
All API communication between SWAS and external systems must be encrypted using TLS 1.3.
User passwords must be stored using PBKDF2 hashing with a minimum of 10,000 iterations.
The system must have an uptime of 99.95% (excluding scheduled maintenance windows on Sundays 2:00 AM - 4:00 AM).
In the event of a database crash, the system must failover to the secondary replica within 60 seconds.
The Web UI must be accessible to color-blind users (avoid red/green only alerts; use icons/shapes).
All critical action buttons (e.g., Cancel Order, Shutdown Robot) must require a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental clicks.
The system must maintain structured log files (ERROR, WARN, INFO) with a standard JSON format for integration with ELK stack.
The codebase must maintain a minimum test coverage of 80% for unit tests and 90% for critical path components.

As a user, I want to securely link my bank account via Plaid API so that transactions are pulled automatically.
As a user, I want to manually add a cash transaction if I pay with physical money.
As a user, I want the AI to automatically tag my transactions (e.g., Starbucks → Food & Dining) so I don’t have to do it manually.
As a user, I want to set a monthly budget for categories like Eating Out and receive alerts when I am at 80% of my limit.
As a user, I want to see a Weekly Summary report so I can review my habits quickly.
As a user, I want to create a Goal (e.g., Save $1000 for a new Phone) and track my progress.
As a user, I want to enable Round-Ups where spare change from purchases goes into my savings vault.
Mobile: Minimum iOS 14 / Android 10. Backend: AWS (ECS Fargate) for containerized microservices.
Cold Start: App must launch and show the dashboard within 2.5 seconds on a 4G network. Background sync must occur every 6 hours to pull new bank transactions without killing the battery.
Sensitive financial data must be encrypted at the application layer (AES-256-GCM) before being sent to the server. Users can optionally enable FaceID/TouchID to unlock the app.
The backend must handle 10,000 concurrent API requests during Payday (1st of the month) without latency degradation.
All user interactions (button clicks, screen views) must be logged to Mixpanel to track feature adoption and funnel drop-offs.
The app must support currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) and date formats (MM/DD vs DD/MM). Default falls back to the device's regional settings.
The system should work properly under normal operating conditions.
annotator_notes: No objective acceptance criterion defines what properly or normal operating conditions mean.
